name: frontend-design
title_zh: 先问「这界面该长什么样」再动手的前端设计顾问
tagline_zh: 受够千篇一律的模板风？它逼你先定视觉方向再写代码，从字体到配色都给你不撞款的选项，让界面有自己的性格。
tagline_en: Tired of cookie-cutter UI? It forces a visual direction before code, offering typography and palette choices with.
desc_en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
why_zh: 它不给你现成组件库，而是先逼你回答「这个界面该传达什么气质」，再基于答案给方向，从根上避开默认模板味。
why_en: It doesn't hand you a component library. It makes you define the interface's temperament first, then guides choices away from.
limit_zh: 只给方向与决策框架，不产出可直接部署的代码或设计稿；需要你已有基础前端能力，且适合从零或重构早期介入。
limit_en: Provides direction and decision frameworks only, no deployable code or design files. Requires basic front-end skills; best at early.
title_en: A front-end design advisor that asks what it should look.
